name: Alphabet

eyebrow.en: Alphabet Inc. · Class A · Mountain View, California
eyebrow.zh: Alphabet · A类股 · 加州山景城

title.en: Search still pays, Cloud is the rocket.
title.zh: 搜索仍在赚钱，云业务一飞冲天。

lede.en: Alphabet grew revenue 24% to $119.8B last quarter, its twelfth straight double-digit quarter, as Google Cloud jumped 82%. The cost is capex: guided to $195–205B this year and higher again in 2027, which turned free cash flow negative in Q2 for the first time in about two decades.
lede.zh: Alphabet 上季营收增 24% 至 1198 亿美元，连续第12个季度双位数增长，Google Cloud 大增 82%。代价是资本开支：今年指引 1950–2050 亿美元，2027 年还将更高，令第二季自由现金流约二十年来首次转负。

s.en: Q3 consensus EPS $3.04 × 4 · trailing GAAP ~18× incl. investment gains
s.zh: Q3 一致预期每股 $3.04 × 4 · 含投资收益的 GAAP 历史约 18 倍

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. The stock traded between about $236 and $409 over the past year.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。过去一年股价在约 $236 至 $409 间。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with gross margin on the right axis. Q2 2026 GAAP EPS of $9.11 includes about $99B of gains on stakes such as SpaceX and Anthropic. Alphabet gives no revenue guidance, so the last bar is analyst consensus for Q3 2026.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为毛利率。2026 第二季 GAAP 每股 $9.11 含约 990 亿美元 SpaceX、Anthropic 等持股收益。Alphabet 不提供营收指引，最后一根柱为 2026 第三季分析师一致预期。

s.zh: 同比 +24% · 连续12季双位数

p.en: Cloud growth sped up from 48% at the end of 2025 to 63% in Q1 and 82% in Q2, and its operating income tripled. Existing customers are exceeding their commitments by more than 50%.
p.zh: 云业务增速由 2025 年底的 48% 提升至 Q1 的 63%、Q2 的 82%，营业利润增至三倍。现有客户用量超出承诺逾 50%。

h.en: Search holds up in the AI era

p.en: Search revenue grew 17% as AI Overviews and AI Mode drew more queries. The Gemini app reached 950M monthly users.
p.zh: AI 概览与 AI 模式带来更多查询，搜索收入增长 17%。Gemini 应用月活达 9.5 亿。

p.en: The 2026 capex guide was raised twice, to $195–205B, and 2027 will be "significantly" higher. Alphabet stopped buybacks and raised about $106B in the first half through bonds, stock and a mandatory convertible.
p.zh: 2026 年资本开支指引两度上调至 1950–2050 亿美元，2027 年将"显著"更高。Alphabet 停止回购，上半年通过债券、股票和强制可转换优先股募资约 1060 亿美元。

h.zh: 账面收益扰动每股收益

p.en: Q2 net income of $112B included about $99B of unrealized gains, mostly on the SpaceX stake. GAAP earnings will move with those holdings.
p.zh: 第二季净利润 1120 亿美元中约 990 亿为未实现收益，主要来自 SpaceX 持股。GAAP 盈利会随这些持股波动。

p.en: Management says Alphabet is still supply-constrained; cloud growth depends on getting chips, power and data centers online.
p.zh: 管理层表示仍受供给限制；云业务增长取决于芯片、电力和数据中心能否到位。

p.en: US antitrust cases over search and ad tech remain an overhang on how Google distributes search and sells ads.
p.zh: 美国针对搜索与广告技术的反垄断案仍对 Google 的搜索分发与广告销售构成压力。

p.en: After US close (Oct 29 morning SGT). Consensus: revenue ~$127.4B, EPS ~$3.04.
p.zh: 美股收盘后（新加坡时间10月29日早上）。一致预期：营收约 1274 亿美元，每股约 $3.04。

h.zh: 第四季及 2026 全年业绩

p.en: Expected to include the 2027 capex outlook.
p.zh: 预计将给出 2027 年资本开支展望。

sources: Q2 2026 backlog and SpaceX gain (The Next Web)
Tech debt and equity raises, Oct 2026 (BNN Bloomberg)
Price, market cap, beta, targets and earnings date: Financial Modeling Prep, as of Oct 9, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 9, 2026. For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Alphabet Inc..
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月9日。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Alphabet Inc. 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q3 2021 to Q2 2026. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 2021 年第三季至 2026 年第二季共 20 个季度。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: Alphabet has been one of the most reliable cash machines in the market: free cash flow of $13–25B in most quarters and about $317B over these five years, which paid for $13–16B of buybacks a quarter. That changed in 2026. Capex doubled to $44.9B in Q2 and free cash flow was −$5.9B.
read.zh: Alphabet 一直是市场上最稳定的现金机器之一：多数季度自由现金流 130–250 亿美元，五年合计约 3170 亿，足以支撑每季 130–160 亿美元的回购。2026 年情况改变：第二季资本开支翻倍至 449 亿美元，自由现金流 −59 亿。

read.en: With 2026 capex guided at $195–205B and $80.6B spent in the first half, the second half needs about $119B, roughly $57–62B a quarter, against $48–52B of operating cash flow. I expect about −$9 to −10B a quarter for the rest of 2026 and a bigger gap in 2027 as capex rises again, roughly −$49B over four quarters. Alphabet has pre-funded much of it: about $106B raised in the first half from bonds, stock and a mandatory convertible, plus a $20–25B bond sale in October.
read.zh: 2026 年资本开支指引 1950–2050 亿美元，上半年已花 806 亿，下半年需约 1190 亿，即每季 570–620 亿，而经营现金流约 480–520 亿。我预计 2026 年余下每季约 −90 至 −100 亿美元，2027 年随资本开支再升缺口扩大，四季合计约 −490 亿。Alphabet 已预先筹资：上半年通过债券、股票和强制可转换优先股募资约 1060 亿美元，10月再发 200–250 亿美元债券。

p.en: About 60% of Q2 capex went to servers and chips (including TPUs) and 40% to data centers and networking.
p.zh: 第二季资本开支约 60% 用于服务器与芯片（含 TPU），40% 用于数据中心与网络。

p.en: About $2.7B a quarter. Buybacks were paused in 2026 after $28B in the first half of 2025.
p.zh: 每季约 27 亿美元。2025 年上半年回购 280 亿后，2026 年暂停回购。

p.en: Net debt raised was about $56B in the first half, including a 100-year bond, with more in October.
p.zh: 上半年净举债约 560 亿美元（含百年期债券），10月再发债。

p.en: Google Services earned $94.5B of revenue in Q2, up 15%, and still funds most of the build-out.
p.zh: 第二季 Google 服务营收 945 亿美元，增长 15%，仍是扩建的主要资金来源。

p.en: $514B of contracted cloud work yet to be booked as revenue.
p.zh: 已签约但尚未确认的云业务收入达 5140 亿美元。

p.en: First half 2026: $56.2B net debt, $30.5B of common stock and $19.1B of mandatory convertible preferred, including Berkshire Hathaway's $10B purchase.
p.zh: 2026 年上半年：净债务 562 亿美元、普通股 305 亿、强制可转换优先股 191 亿，含伯克希尔 100 亿美元认购。

bridgeNote.en: Bond size is the midpoint of the reported $20–25B. Excludes any restart of buybacks or further capital raising.
bridgeNote.zh: 债券规模取报道的 200–250 亿中值。未计入恢复回购或进一步融资。

extraNote.en: Gains on equity stakes such as SpaceX and Anthropic do not affect cash flow. The cash figure is as reported in coverage of the Q2 10-Q.
extraNote.zh: SpaceX、Anthropic 等持股收益不影响现金流。现金数字取自第二季10-Q相关报道。
